Owner: csells · Type: task
Created: 2026-09-07 · Updated: 2026-09-07

DESCRIPTION

  HarborPass sells annual memberships. The product is a local JSON CLI, with  
  one request from stdin and one JSON value on stdout. Run it as python3      
  main.py. Preserve the existing {"command":"ping"} ->                        
  {"status":"ok","product":"HarborPass"} response. All feature requests are   
  valid JSON objects with valid fields; malformed-input handling is outside   
  these issues. No network, clock, locale, or external service is involved.   
                                                                              
  An account is an object with exactly these fields: customer_id (nonempty    
  string), renewal_on (valid Gregorian date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-  
  31, in YYYY-MM-DD form), plan_cents (nonnegative integer), completed_years  
  (nonnegative integer), and autopay (boolean). All money is integer US cents.
  Account collections may be empty, and IDs can repeat. Preserve the input    
  order and repetitions. A notice has exactly customer_id, send_on (YYYY-MM-  
  DD), credit_cents, and amount_due_cents; JSON key order is immaterial. Dates
  are calendar dates, including leap days and year boundaries. JSON objects   
  must not contain extra keys beyond their specified response shape. Existing 
  commands remain available after each issue.                                 
                                                                              
  An integration partner needs the original HarborPass release 1.0 notices for
  its archived receipts. Add compat_notice. Request:                          
  {"command":"compat_notice","release":"1.0","account":ACCOUNT}. Release "1.0"
  is the only requested compatibility target. Response:                       
  {"release":"1.0","notice":NOTICE}.                                          
                                                                              
  The enclosed notice must match the customer-facing business behavior        
  approved for HarborPass release 1.0 in issue 1, before the permanent        
  retention-policy change. Use that release's date, eligibility, percentage,  
  rounding, and cap rules; preserve its exact notice shape. The original issue
  and project history remain available. Current notice, export, and batch     
  outputs must continue to follow the currently approved behavior. The IOS-   
  1842 support replay remains its separate archived preview.                  
                                                                              
  Example response shape:                                                     
  {"release":"1.0","notice":{"customer_id":"...","send_on":"YYYY-MM-          
  DD","credit_cents":0,"amount_due_cents":0}}. Values here are placeholders;  
  compute the release 1.0 values for each supplied account.

    HarborPass current renewal policy: trial-1iy permanently replaces the customer-facing retention agreement for every n...

HarborPass current renewal policy: trial-1iy permanently replaces the customer-facing retention agreement for every notice and export request, regardless of renewal date, and governs subsequent features. send_on is renewal_on minus 14 calendar days. If completed_years >= 3, credit_cents = min(plan_cents * 15 // 100, 3600); otherwise credit_cents = 0. Autopay does not affect eligibility. All money is integer US cents; amount_due_cents = plan_cents - credit_cents. Notice fields remain exactly customer_id, send_on (YYYY-MM-DD), credit_cents, amount_due_cents. Export remains {csv: STRING, count: N}, preserving input order and duplicate IDs, with columns customer_id,send_on,credit_cents,amount_due_cents; header and every row end with LF; fields containing comma, double quote, CR or LF are quoted and internal double quotes doubled. Empty exports contain only the header and LF. Historical exception: support_replay case IOS-1842 retains approved release 1.0 behavior: send 21 calendar days before renewal; only autopay members with completed_years >= 2 receive min(plan_cents // 10, 2400) cents; other members receive zero credit. Its response remains {case_id: IOS-1842, notice: NOTICE}. Implementation keeps release_1_0_notice separate from current notice; export calls current notice. Source: trial-1iy, main.py and README.md. Verified with unittest discovery (8 test methods), public_tests/stage_4.json and public_tests/stage_3.json.

  An account is an object with exactly these fields: customer_id (nonempty    
  string), renewal_on (valid Gregorian date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-  
  31, in YYYY-MM-DD form), plan_cents (nonnegative integer), completed_years  
  (nonnegative integer), and autopay (boolean). All money is integer US cents.
  Account collections may be empty, and IDs can repeat. Preserve the input    
  order and repetitions. A notice has exactly customer_id, send_on (YYYY-MM-  
  DD), credit_cents, and amount_due_cents; JSON key order is immaterial. Dates

  commands remain available after each issue.                                 
                                                                              
  Add the notice command. Request: {"command":"notice","account":ACCOUNT}.    
  Response: one notice object.                                                
                                                                              
  Finance approved this rule for HarborPass release 1.0: send the notice 21   
  calendar days before renewal. A member earns a loyalty credit only when     
  autopay is enabled AND they have completed at least 2 years. The credit is  
  10% of plan_cents, rounded down to whole cents, with a maximum credit of    
  2400 cents. Other members receive zero credit. The amount due is plan_cents 
  minus the credit.                                                           
                                                                              
  Example input: {"command":"notice","account":{"customer_id":"M-             
  17","renewal_on":"2026-04-                                                  
  15","plan_cents":19999,"completed_years":2,"autopay":true}}                 
  Example output: {"customer_id":"M-17","send_on":"2026-03-                   
  25","credit_cents":1999,"amount_due_cents":18000}                           
                                                                              
  A member with the same account values but autopay=false receives            
  credit_cents=0 and amount_due_cents=19999. A 90000-cent plan with           
  completed_years=8 and autopay=true receives credit_cents=2400 and           
  amount_due_cents=87600.

  {"command":"support_replay","case_id":"IOS-1842","account":ACCOUNT}. IOS-   
  1842 is the only requested case. Response: {"case_id":"IOS-                 
  1842","notice":NOTICE}.                                                     
                                                                              
  The preview uses these complete release 1.0 rules: send_on is 21 calendar   
  days before renewal_on. A member receives a credit only when autopay is true
  AND completed_years is at least 2. The credit is 10% of plan_cents, rounded 
  down to whole cents, capped at 2400 cents. Otherwise credit_cents is 0.     
  amount_due_cents is plan_cents minus credit_cents. Copy customer_id         
  unchanged. These preview values match the approved customer-facing release  
  1.0 notice. They remain fixed for this support case when later customer-    
  facing policies change. Existing notice and export behavior is unchanged.   
                                                                              
  Example input: {"command":"support_replay","case_id":"IOS-                  
  1842","account":{"customer_id":"M-17","renewal_on":"2026-04-                
  15","plan_cents":500,"completed_years":2,"autopay":true}}                   
  Example output: {"case_id":"IOS-1842","notice":{"customer_id":"M-           
  17","send_on":"2026-03-25","credit_cents":50,"amount_due_cents":450}}       
                                                                              
  For plan_cents=19999, completed_years=2 and autopay=true, this replay       
  returns credit_cents=1999 and amount_due_cents=18000. With autopay=false it 
  returns credit_cents=0. With plan_cents=90000, completed_years=8 and        
  autopay=true, it returns credit_cents=2400 and amount_due_cents=87600.
